function.name: calculate_density
function.description: Calculate the population density of a specific country in a specific year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

country.description: The country for which the density needs to be calculated.

year.description: The year in which the density is to be calculated.

land_area.description: The land area of the country in square kilometers. This is a float type value.

function.name: crime_record_get_record
function.description: Retrieve detailed felony crime records using a specific case number and location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

case_number.description: The case number related to the crime.

county.description: The county in which the crime occurred.

details.description: To get a detailed report, set as true. Defaults to false.

function.name: get_highest_scoring_player
function.description: Retrieve the highest scoring player in a specific game and season. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

game.description: The game in which you want to find the highest scoring player.

season.description: The season during which the high score was achieved.

region.description: The geographical region in which the game is being played (Optional). Defaults to 'USA'

function.name: calculate_compound_interest
function.description: Calculates the compound interest of an investment over a given time period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

principle.description: The initial amount of the investment. This is a float type value.

interest_rate.description: The yearly interest rate of the investment. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time, in years, the money is invested or borrowed for.

compounds_per_year.description: The number of times the interest is compounded per year. Default is 1 (interest is compounded yearly).
